entities.summary: Jörg Arthur Freyhof is a German ichthyologist specializing on Old World cypriniform fishes. Freyhof has worked at the Alexander Koenig Research Museum, Bonn, and since 2000 he has been employed at the Leibniz Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, Berlin.
